clue: This head elf explains the 'Santa Clause' rules to Scott Calvin at the North Pole.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Bernard! Played by David Krumholtz. [laughs] He has seen a lot of new Santas.

clue: Jack Skellington's ghost dog has a glowing jack-o'-lantern nose. Name him.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Zero! [chuckles] His nose lights the way for Jack's sleigh on a foggy Christmas Eve.

clue: Marnie, Dylan and Sophie learn they come from a family of witches with this last name.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Cromwell! Grandma Aggie Cromwell, to be exact. [laughs] Witches on Mom's side.

clue: In 1999, Disneyland rethemed its Swiss Family Treehouse into this jungle hero's treehouse.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Tarzan! [chuckles] The Robinsons moved out and the apes moved in.

clue: Max goes on the cross-country road trip hoping to impress this girl he likes.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Roxanne! [laughs] All he had to do was ask her out.

clue: Hayley Mills's cheerful orphan teaches a whole town to play this optimistic game.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Glad Game! [chuckles] Find something to be glad about, no matter what.

clue: At Camp Rock, Shane Gray is the lead singer of this pop band.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Connect 3! Played by the Jonas Brothers. [laughs] Rock star, meet summer camp.

clue: Fantasia 2000's finale shows a spring sprite reviving a forest, set to this Stravinsky ballet suite.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is The Firebird Suite! [sighs] Fire, ash, then spring comes back.
